p: trust: He shows that we cannot call on God unless we trust in him.
goodness extendeth not to thee: Though we cannot enrich God, yet we must bestow God's gifts for the use of his children.
sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten: As grief of conscience and miserable destruction.
their drink offerings of blood will: He would neither by outward profession nor in heart, nor in mouth consent to their idolatries.
lines are fallen unto me in: With which my portion is measured.
shall not be moved: The faithful are sure to persevere to the end.
my heart is glad: That is, I rejoice both in body and in soul.
wilt not leave my soul in: This is chiefly meant by Christ, by whose resurrection all his members have immortality.
presence is fulness of joy: Where God favours there is perfect happiness.
